text.title: 访客证
text.situation:
开放日一周后，玛雅和乔乘长途汽车来到附近学院。乔安排了参观工程实作室。在接待处，玛雅拿着一夹社区中心的照片。接待员打印访客通行证时，她放下文件夹。这张证让她们通过实作室门禁，并不是车票。

接待员：请把通行证戴在我们看得见的位置。玻璃门后就是实作室。
玛雅：我们在这里等吗？
接待员：陈博士会来接你们。
透过门，玛雅注意到一辆推车穿过实作室地板的移动。一位学生在工作台之间慢慢推着它。

paragraphs.en: A week after the open day, Maya and Jo took a coach to a nearby college. Jo had arranged a visit to an engineering workshop. At reception, Maya was carrying a folder of photographs from the centre. She put it down while the receptionist printed a visitor’s pass. The pass would let them through the workshop gate; it was not a travel ticket.

paragraphs.en:
Receptionist: Please wear your pass where we can see it. The workshop is after the glass doors.
Maya: Shall we wait here?
Receptionist: Dr Chen will come to meet you.
Through the doors, Maya noticed the movement of a trolley across the workshop floor. A student pushed it slowly between the benches.

S07.P01.T01.cue: 你带着画筒来到博物馆。说明所带物品，并询问入场。
acceptableAnswers: 我带着一些图画。在哪里领访客证？
